grade: planning-grade, i-Tree Eco style multipliers; not a field survey

program.species_tall_segments: green walls + honeylocust (Gleditsia triacanthos inermis), open crown, no canopy closure
program.species_shallow_segments: honeylocust, Kentucky coffeetree, zelkova; no London plane or dense-crown species in H/W>0.5 segments
program.salt_tolerance: honeylocust, coffeetree, zelkova rated salt-tolerant (Cornell Urban Horticulture Institute)

deegan_cap.note: The cap also removes the source at grade; the removal figure understates its effect.

honesty: About 11 lb/yr of PM2.5 removed across the corridor does not offset a +1.29 ug/m3 ambient rise at the Deegan sensor. Vegetation is a breathing-height intervention; the source is the highway.
